stem.text: A variable force is applied to ensure that a constant power is supplied to a train.
Which graph best shows the variation of the force $F$ applied with the velocity $v$ of the train?

A.alt: Graph with F on the vertical axis and v on the horizontal axis, showing a curve falling from the F axis and levelling off.

B.alt: Graph with F on the vertical axis and v on the horizontal axis, showing a straight line rising from the origin.

C.alt: Graph with F on the vertical axis and v on the horizontal axis, showing a curve rising from the origin and levelling off.

D.alt: Graph with F on the vertical axis and v on the horizontal axis, showing a curve rising from the origin with increasing steepness.
